messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P0 — inference-usw pool: multiple nodes reporting NotReady and kubelet restarts. Pager: https://pagerduty/INC12345

pagerduty: Triggered escalation to on-call.

alex: Ack, I’m taking the page.

maya: I’m on it, pulling recent kubelet logs and pod events.

sam: seeing a big spike in 5xxs from inference-api-usw, error-rate +18% over 3m.

lee: quick glance at node logs: GPU driver OOMs and container restarts on infer-usw-42 and infer-usw-44. stack shows CUDNN alloc failure.

maya: copying logs here —
```
Dec 08 12:03:45 infer-usw-42 kubelet: container runtime: containerd: exit code 137
E tensorflow: CUDNN_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```

natalie: is this localized to one AZ or across the pool?

sam: looks like 3 nodes in the same AZ flapped within 2m. routing layer still sending to pool.

maya: cordoning the worst node to stop new pods: `kubectl cordon infer-usw-42 --context=cluster-usw`

incident-bot: Runbook suggestion: drain node after cordon if node is unhealthy for >2m.

maya: initiating safe drain: `kubectl drain infer-usw-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` — starting eviction.

sam: kicked up fallback pool by +4 replicas and rerouting ~20% traffic to inference-usw-fallback. autoscaler bot reports scale ok.

lee: logs show runtime writer entering restart-loop, likely leaking GPU memory across sessions.

maya: attempting kubelet restart to clear cgroups and stuck containers: `ssh root@infer-usw-42 'sudo systemctl restart kubelet'`

alex: restart issued. monitoring metrics.

(1m later)

maya: kubelet came back up, node is Ready but some pods still CrashLoopBackOff.

natalie: draining completed, pods evicted to fallback pool. short errors observed during eviction spike.

sam: overall 5xx rate reduced to +4% above baseline, tail latency still elevated for a bit.

lee: will patch runtime to add stricter cgroup memory limits and guard OOMs, opening an issue: INF-3942.

maya: uncordoning node now after sanity checks: `kubectl uncordon infer-usw-42` — allowing scheduling.

alex: marking page resolved in PagerDuty, but leaving incident open for postmortem.

alex: customer impact: transient increased errors for customers routed to inference-usw between 12:02–12:08 UTC (approx). status page updated.

natalie: follow-up action items: add kubelet OOM alert threshold, broaden cgroup enforcement in runtime, add automated node recycle when GPU OOM pattern detected.

lee: will work on a hotfix for runtime to fail fast on GPU alloc failures and release a canary to staging.

alex: thanks all — handing incident to postmortem queue. closing the on-call handoff. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P0 resolved and assigned to INF-3942 for follow-up.
